correctness.rationale: Dimensionless backward generator is Lp=Delta+g dtheta²+p utheta·grad with absorbing unit-circle boundary, g>0. The zeroth mean T0=(1-rho²)/4 and first angular coefficient h=[I1(sqrt(g)rho)/I1(sqrt(g))-rho]/(2g) solve the Dirichlet hierarchy. Averaging the p² equation yields w_g'=-h/2; integrating gives the claimed Bessel C_g(s). Setting f=-h/rho lifts the equation to the 4D radial Dirichlet resolvent (-Delta_4+g)f=1/2; its killed Brownian occupation representation makes (-1)^k d_g^k C_g(s)>0 for all integers k>=0, all 0<=s<1 and all g>0. The g downarrow0 and g infinity limits follow by 4D Poisson and resolvent convergence; rim is explicitly nonuniform in the latter regime. Independent Bessel/ODE-integral and high-precision derivative checks matched 9 parameter pairs, k=0..3, but the analytic resolvent proves the universal signs.
